shortDescription: Manage individual OpenVPN Client Specific Overrides.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: block
options.description: Enables or disables the client from connecting to this server. Do not use this option to permanently disable a client due to a compromised key or password. Use a CRL instead.

options.name: common_name
options.description: The X.509 common name for the client certificate, or the username for VPNs utilizing password authentication.

options.name: custom_options
options.description: Additional OpenVPN options to add for this client.

options.name: description
options.description: The description for this client specific override.

options.name: disable
options.description: Disables this client specific override.

options.name: dns_domain
options.description: The default domain to provide to the client.

options.name: dns_server1
options.description: The primary DNS server to provide to the client.

options.name: dns_server2
options.description: The secondary DNS server to provide to the client.

options.name: dns_server3
options.description: The tertiary DNS server to provide to the client.

options.name: dns_server4
options.description: The quaternary DNS server to provide to the client.

options.name: gwredir
options.description: Enable forcing all client-generated traffic through the tunnel.

options.name: local_network
options.description: The IPv4 server-side networks that will be accessible from this particular client.

options.name: local_networkv6
options.description: the IPv6 server-side networks that will be accessible from this particular client.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: netbios_enable
options.description: Enables or disables NetBIOS over TCP/IP.

options.name: netbios_ntype
options.description: The NetBIOS node type.

options.name: netbios_scope
options.description: The NetBIOS Scope ID. This provides an extended naming service for NetBIOS over TCP/IP. The NetBIOS scope ID isolates NetBIOS traffic on a single network to only those nodes with the same NetBIOS scope ID.

options.name: ntp_server1
options.description: The primary NTP server to provide to the client.

options.name: ntp_server2
options.description: The secondary NTP server to provide to the client.

options.name: push_reset
options.description: Enables or disables preventing this client from receiving any server-defined client settings.

options.name: remote_network
options.description: The IPv4 client-side networks that will be routed to this client specifically using iroute, so that a site-to-site VPN can be established.

options.name: remote_networkv6
options.description: The IPv6 client-side networks that will be routed to this client specifically using iroute, so that a site-to-site VPN can be established.

options.name: remove_options
options.description: Specifies the push-remove options to apply to the client

options.name: server_list
options.description: The OpenVPN servers that will utilize this override. When no servers are specified, the override will apply to all servers.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: tunnel_network
options.description: The IPv4 virtual network used for private communications between the server and client hosts.

options.name: tunnel_networkv6
options.description: The IPv6 virtual network used for private communications between the server and client hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.

options.name: wins_server1
options.description: The primary WINS server to provide to the client.

options.name: wins_server2
options.description: The secondary WINS server to provide to the client.
